segments.title: Polar bears have black skin!
segments.say: Hi friends! I'm Maya from Churchill, Canada. Did you know polar bears have black skin?

segments.title: White fur, black skin!
segments.say: Under all that white fur, a polar bear's skin is black!

segments.title: Babies start pink
segments.say: Cubs are born with pink skin. It turns black when they are three or four months old.

segments.title: Why black skin?
segments.say: Why do scientists think it's black? To hide, to soak up the sun, or to look cool? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Soak up the sun!
segments.say: Soak up the sun! Dark colors catch the sun's warmth, and may protect from strong sunlight too.
